description: This file contains test cases for a FastAPI application, testing various POST request scenarios to the '/login/' endpoint with form data and JSON, as well as retrieving the OpenAPI schema. It uses pytest fixtures and the FastAPI TestClient to perform HTTP requests and validate responses.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports the module specified by the request parameter to instantiate and return a TestClient for the FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_post_body_form(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request with form data containing 'username' and 'password', expects a 200 response and matching JSON.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_password(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request missing 'password', expects a 422 validation error indicating missing field.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_username(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request missing 'username', expects a 422 validation error indicating missing field.

methods.name: test_post_body_form_no_data(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request with no data, expects 422 validation errors for both missing fields.

methods.name: test_post_body_json(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests POST request with JSON payload instead of form data; expects validation error.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the OpenAPI schema from the FastAPI app, ensuring it matches the expected structure and data.

search-terms: pytest fixture for dynamic module import
